video:video.video:title: How to Check if a Car is Stolen Using VIN Number (Free Method)
video:video.video:description: Buying a used car? Check the VIN FIRST! SafeOrStolen verifies vehicles against NCIC stolen vehicle database, insurance theft claims, police reports, and state DMV records. VIN check reveals stolen status, salvage title, flood damage, and odometer fraud. Find VIN on dashboard driver's side, driver's door jamb, title document, insurance card, or vehicle registration.

video:video.video:title: Free IMEI Checker - Verify Your Phone Isn't Stolen or Blacklisted
video:video.video:description: Buying a used iPhone or Android? Check the IMEI first! SafeOrStolen IMEI checker shows stolen status, blacklisted carriers, insurance claims, activation lock status, and iCloud lock. Find your IMEI by dialing *#06#, in Settings About Phone, back of device, SIM tray, or original box. Protect yourself from buying stolen or blacklisted phones.
